verdict.rationale: Tax calculation is a fair axis for a subscription billing platform like Recurly, so it applies. However, no item in the evidence pack mentions sales tax, VAT, or GST calculation, tax registrations, rates, or a tax-engine integration. The invoicing, credit-invoice, and RevRec items cover other capabilities and do not transfer to this story.

support.subject: As a finance lead, sales tax, VAT, and GST are calculated on every invoice — natively or through a first-class tax integration — with the right registrations and rates
